task: Fix two premium-model tip defects in the chat UI: the tip does not re-appear for a new chat after dismissal, and the premium tooltip is shown constantly on hover across the whole prompt container.

key_reasoning.reason: Four coordinating components: ChatHistory (owns premiumTipKey / dismissedPremiumTipKey / tipIsVisible), ChatPrompt (duplicate isPremiumActive derivation plus the container-level tooltip anchor), ChatPage (hasHistory mount gate and the key={currentChat?.id} remount boundary), and the premium hover surfaces shared with PremiumModelBadge and ChatPromptLlmSelector. Cross-cutting concerns include the global react-tooltip instance in src/utils/tooltip.ts (openEvents mouseover bubbling, clickable) and the useChatScroll layoutDeps coupling.

Symptoms are concrete but the target semantics are not settled: the dismissal scope (per chat, per (chatId, modelValue), per session, or persisted per (userId, chatId) via chatStorageUtils) is an open design decision, and the two recorded review artifacts conflict — the 2026-08-14 check records re-arm on chat or model change while CR-002 in the 2026-08-17 review records that dismissal must be preserved across brief unmount/remount cycles. New chats have id='' and empty history, so the intended tip behaviour for the unsaved-chat phase must be defined before implementation.

No exact precedent for re-arming in-memory tip state across the deliberate ChatPage remount keys; the previous two attempts in this area each introduced a regression (CR-001 scroll re-anchor, CR-002 undefined key). Fixing the constant-hover symptom may require touching the single global react-tooltip config used by ~40 components, and tipIsVisible feeds useChatScroll layoutDeps behind an eslint-disable, so a visibility change can shift scroll behaviour. Zero test coverage exists on premiumTipKey, the re-arm guard, chat-switch flows, or the prompt-container tooltip attribute, so both defects are currently invisible to CI.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M (3) to L (4): touches core shared utilities — the global react-tooltip instance in src/utils/tooltip.ts serves ~40 components, and the PREMIUM_MODEL_TOOLTIP constant is shared across PremiumModelBadge, ChatPromptLlmSelector, and the ChatPrompt container anchor.

Requirements Clarity bumped from M (3) to L (4): vague acceptance criteria — the desired dismissal persistence scope and new-chat re-arm semantics are undefined, and the two recorded code-review artifacts state expectations that are not obviously compatible.
